summary: Test-writing run (red phase) for issue #5: committed permanent stubbed-response tests that pin the contract of the OpenAPI-generated Swift client (canary module test + per-surface contract tests incl. the previously unimplemented ranked-results endpoint and typed 401 handling), plus docs/openapi-client-migration.md recording the pinned implementation contract, the prose-contract deltas, and endpoint gaps. All new tests intentionally fail to compile at this head (missing ColorMatchingOpenAPI module, APIClient.fetchRankedResults, RankedResults/RankedPairResult, APIError.unauthorized) — the red-phase signal the implementation run must resolve. No Swift toolchain exists in this container and the upstream spec (viamin/color_matching#110) is unreachable through the GitHub proxy, so tests were validated by review and the spec-dependent deltas are recorded as deferred work; CI (macOS swift test) is the executor.
